name: Fighter Blade Dancer
body:
The blade dancer is a blur of steel motion, their blades cutting apart their enemies in a graceful dance of death.

Acrobatic Skill (Ex)

A blade dancer gains Acrobatics as a class skill.

Unfettered Skill (Ex)

A blade dancer relies on their skill with a blade and their agility to protect them in combat as heavy armor would only hinder their movements. The blade dancer gains a +1 dodge bonus to their AC when unarmored or wearing light armor.

This bonus increases by 1 at 3rd, 7th, 11th, 15th, and 19th levels.

This ability replaces the proficiency with medium armor, heavy armor, and shields, armor training and armor mastery.

Slashing Finesse (Ex)

At 1st level, the blade dancer gains Weapon Finesse and may treat any one-handed slashing weapon as a light weapon.

This ability replaces the combat feat gained at 1st level.

Movement Mastery (Ex)

At 2nd level, a blade dancer may take 10 on Acrobatics or Perform (dance) checks even when stress or distraction would normally prevent them from doing so.

This ability replaces bravery.

Alacrity (Ex)

At 3rd level, a blade dancer gains a +5 enhancement bonus to their base speed. This bonus only applies while wearing light or no armor. This enhancement bonus increases to +10 at 11th and to +15 at 19th levels.

Slashing Mastery (Ex)

At 5th level, a blade dancer gains the benefits of weapon training but only with one-handed or light slashing weapons. They may not select additional weapon groups at later levels.

This ability replaces weapon training.

Blade Dance (Ex)

At 6th level, a blade dancer is a flowing cyclone of blades. Once per day, they may enter a blade dance and move up to their speed while making a melee full-attack action. The blade dancer must move at least 5 feet between each attack and may not return to a square they have just exited. The blade dancer is subject to attacks of opportunity from these attacks but may use Acrobatics as part of this movement. If the blade dancer is prevented from making the move, they are also prevented from making the rest of their attacks.

This ability is only usable while the blade dancer is wielding a one-handed or light slashing weapon.

Additionally, the blade dancer cannot be wearing medium or heavy armor, nor can they be using skills that require them to be quiet or still.

The blade dance remains active for 1 round per two ranks in Perform (dance) (minimum 1 round).

The blade dancer gains an additional use of this ability at 9th, 13th, and 17th levels.

This ability replaces the bonus combat feat gained at 6th level.

A Thousand Cuts (Ex)

At 20th level, a blade dancer can double the number attacks they make once per day, whether in a blade dance or not. If used in conjunction with blade dance, the two attacks can be made between movement if so chosen. The doubled attacks are at each of the -5 BAB iterations of your normal full attack.

This extra set of attacks does stack with spells like haste.

This ability replaces weapon mastery.
